overview.startPoint: Talk to Azzanadra at the Council of Burthorpe upstairs in the Burthorpe Castle.

extra.label: League notes
extra.html: The quest can't be completed, as takes place across Asgarnia Kandarin Karamja Misthalin Desert while the prerequisite quests also require Anachronia.

blocks.html: Go up the stairs in Burthorpe Castle.
blocks.text: Go up the stairs in Burthorpe Castle.

blocks.html: Talk to Azzanadra at the north-west corner.
blocks.text: Talk to Azzanadra at the north-west corner.

substeps.html: Before continuing, make sure Azzanadra asks you to meet at Kharid-et Dig Site. Use the quest log if needed.
substeps.text: Before continuing, make sure Azzanadra asks you to meet at Kharid-et Dig Site. Use the quest log if needed.

blocks.html: Travel to Kharid-et Dig Site (use dig sites map or other means) and enter the main fortress. Talk to Azzanadra at the Praetorium war table (not in the Praetorium).
blocks.text: Travel to Kharid-et Dig Site (use dig sites map or other means) and enter the main fortress. Talk to Azzanadra at the Praetorium war table (not in the Praetorium).
Travel through Freneskae

blocks.html: Travel to the World Gate and talk to Azzanadra. Teleporting, logging out or going to lobby will require starting this part over from this step.
blocks.text: Travel to the World Gate and talk to Azzanadra. Teleporting, logging out or going to lobby will require starting this part over from this step.

substeps.html: Use the Sixth-Age circuit to teleport, or run south from the Eagles' Peak lodestone, or teleport to the Outpost with a traveller's necklace and run west.
substeps.text: Use the Sixth-Age circuit to teleport, or run south from the Eagles' Peak lodestone, or teleport to the Outpost with a traveller's necklace and run west.

blocks.html: Equip a face mask or masked earmuffs to protect against volcanic ash. Having a slayer helmet on the slayer helmet stand counts for this.
blocks.text: Equip a face mask or masked earmuffs to protect against volcanic ash. Having a slayer helmet on the slayer helmet stand counts for this.

blocks.html: Enter the World Gate, travelling to the 'Approach' destination (first option). Make sure to finish the dialogue with Azzanadra upon entry.
blocks.text: Enter the World Gate, travelling to the 'Approach' destination (first option). Make sure to finish the dialogue with Azzanadra upon entry.

blocks.html: Head east over the ledges, then up the cliffside.
blocks.text: Head east over the ledges, then up the cliffside.

blocks.html: Continue east, climbing down the drop, then talk to Azzanadra to the south-east.
blocks.text: Continue east, climbing down the drop, then talk to Azzanadra to the south-east.

blocks.html: Continue north, crossing the stepping stones and up the cliffside.
blocks.text: Continue north, crossing the stepping stones and up the cliffside.

blocks.html: Continue north, wall run the overhang and talk to Azzanadra again.
blocks.text: Continue north, wall run the overhang and talk to Azzanadra again.

blocks.html: Climb the cliffside, continue west and slide down the slope and head west.
blocks.text: Climb the cliffside, continue west and slide down the slope and head west.

substeps.html: You can heal up by standing under the archway with the glowing crystals.
substeps.text: You can heal up by standing under the archway with the glowing crystals.

blocks.html: Continue south, wrapping around east and north, then climb the nearby cliffside which is south of the archway.
blocks.text: Continue south, wrapping around east and north, then climb the nearby cliffside which is south of the archway.

blocks.html: Walk across the rock formation and talk to Azzanadra again.
blocks.text: Walk across the rock formation and talk to Azzanadra again.

blocks.html: Continue east and climb down the drop, then traverse the rock bridge to the east.
blocks.text: Continue east and climb down the drop, then traverse the rock bridge to the east.

blocks.html: Talk to Azzanadra again.
blocks.text: Talk to Azzanadra again.

blocks.html: Enter the opening.
blocks.text: Enter the opening.

blocks.html: Talk to Azzanadra.
blocks.text: Talk to Azzanadra.

blocks.html: Inspect the fragmented sphere at each end of the halls.
blocks.text: Inspect the fragmented sphere at each end of the halls.

blocks.html: Talk to Ariane back at the centre, she gives you a blank observation. Azzanadra will replace this if you lost yours.
blocks.text: Talk to Ariane back at the centre, she gives you a blank observation. Azzanadra will replace this if you lost yours.

blocks.html: Collect memories from the elder god memory wisps (50 each).
blocks.text: Collect memories from the elder god memory wisps (50 each).

blocks.html: Inspect the blank observation in your backpack.
blocks.text: Inspect the blank observation in your backpack.

blocks.html: Talk to Azzanadra.
blocks.text: Talk to Azzanadra.

blocks.html: Light voice and Shadow voice will speak to you.
blocks.text: Light voice and Shadow voice will speak to you.

options.text: I've heard enough. I have a world to save.

blocks.html: Travel to White Knights' Castle in Falador and enter the courtyard. Talk to Sir Upticious near the entrance.
blocks.text: Travel to White Knights' Castle in Falador and enter the courtyard. Talk to Sir Upticious near the entrance.

blocks.html: Go up the eastern ladder, then up the staircase by Sir Renitee to the altar in the castle. Talk to Father Frith.
blocks.text: Go up the eastern ladder, then up the staircase by Sir Renitee to the altar in the castle. Talk to Father Frith.

blocks.html: Go to the ground floor (UK) / 1st floor (US), walk one room west from the ladder and talk to Sir Owen.
blocks.text: Go to the ground floor (UK) / 1st floor (US), walk one room west from the ladder and talk to Sir Owen.

blocks.html: Return upstairs and talk to Father Frith.
blocks.text: Return upstairs and talk to Father Frith.

blocks.html: Talk to Sir Amik Varze on the 2nd floor (UK) / 3rd floor (US) in the west wing of the castle.
blocks.text: Talk to Sir Amik Varze on the 2nd floor (UK) / 3rd floor (US) in the west wing of the castle.

blocks.html: Talk to Padomenes in the courtyard.
blocks.text: Talk to Padomenes in the courtyard.

blocks.html: Talk to Sir Vyvin, found next to Sir Owen, located in the room south of Father Frith on 2nd floor (UK) / 3rd floor (US).
blocks.text: Talk to Sir Vyvin, found next to Sir Owen, located in the room south of Father Frith on 2nd floor (UK) / 3rd floor (US).

blocks.html: Talk to Sir Owen on the ground floor (UK) / 1<sup>st</sup> floor (US), in the room west of the ladder.
blocks.text: Talk to Sir Owen on the ground floor (UK) / 1st floor (US), in the room west of the ladder.

blocks.html: Open, then search the nearby drawers.
blocks.text: Open, then search the nearby drawers.

blocks.html: Go up the ladder into Sir Renitee's room and crack open the safe.
blocks.text: Go up the ladder into Sir Renitee's room and crack open the safe.

blocks.html: Right-click the Slayer bell and use the 'Cut clapper' option to create a silent bell.
blocks.text: Right-click the Slayer bell and use the 'Cut clapper' option to create a silent bell.

blocks.html: Travel to the Paterdomus and enter the Mausoleum to the north.
blocks.text: Travel to the Paterdomus and enter the Mausoleum to the north.

substeps.html: Use the Skeletal horror Teleport or invitation box to get there quickly.
substeps.text: Use the Skeletal horror Teleport or invitation box to get there quickly.

blocks.html: Use the bell on the well to create a silent bell (blessed).
blocks.text: Use the bell on the well to create a silent bell (blessed).

blocks.html: Return to Saradomin's throne in the White Knights' Castle by the altar and next to Father Frith on 2<sup>nd</sup> floor (UK) / 3<sup>rd</sup> floor (US).
blocks.text: Return to Saradomin's throne in the White Knights' Castle by the altar and next to Father Frith on 2nd floor (UK) / 3rd floor (US).

blocks.html: Ring the bell three times, calling Saradomin's name each time.
blocks.text: Ring the bell three times, calling Saradomin's name each time.

blocks.html: Speak to Saradomin.
blocks.text: Speak to Saradomin.

options.text: We need to find the eggs.

blocks.html: Travel to Kharid-et and talk to Azzanadra at the Praetorium war table.
blocks.text: Travel to Kharid-et and talk to Azzanadra at the Praetorium war table.

blocks.html: Travel to the Hall of Memories (use the Sixth-Age circuit or memory strands to teleport to Memorial to Guthix)
blocks.text: Travel to the Hall of Memories (use the Sixth-Age circuit or memory strands to teleport to Memorial to Guthix)

blocks.html: Enter the pool.
blocks.text: Enter the pool.

blocks.html: Capture the 6 Archivist's memories, then talk to the Archivist.
blocks.text: Capture the 6 Archivist's memories, then talk to the Archivist.

blocks.html: Capture the 6 restricted memories.
blocks.text: Capture the 6 restricted memories.

blocks.html: Interact with each of the plinths in the north-west and north-east.
blocks.text: Interact with each of the plinths in the north-west and north-east.

blocks.html: Search the memory bud in the centre to receive a restricted engram.
blocks.text: Search the memory bud in the centre to receive a restricted engram.

blocks.html: Leave the Hall of Memories and use the restricted engram on the fountain of energy.
blocks.text: Leave the Hall of Memories and use the restricted engram on the fountain of energy.

blocks.html: Travel to the entrance of the TzHaar City (use the TokKul-Zo to teleport to the main plaza then run south and exit the volcano). You can use the boss portal or the combat portal attuned to TzHaar Fight Cave to get there.
blocks.text: Travel to the entrance of the TzHaar City (use the TokKul-Zo to teleport to the main plaza then run south and exit the volcano). You can use the boss portal or the combat portal attuned to TzHaar Fight Cave to get there.

substeps.html: Alternatively, fairy ring BLP is located near the fight cave. From here, leave the city through the exit to the south.
substeps.text: Alternatively, fairy ring BLP is located near the fight cave. From here, leave the city through the exit to the south.

blocks.html: Talk to Trindine on the surface of Karamja Volcano.
blocks.text: Talk to Trindine on the surface of Karamja Volcano.

blocks.html: Enter the city, talk to Ga'al just north of the entrance.
blocks.text: Enter the city, talk to Ga'al just north of the entrance.

blocks.html: Go north to the main plaza (you can teleport back here using the TokKul-Zo), talk to Trindine.
blocks.text: Go north to the main plaza (you can teleport back here using the TokKul-Zo), talk to Trindine.

blocks.html: Talk to TokHaar-Hok.
blocks.text: Talk to TokHaar-Hok.

blocks.html: Travel to the TzHaar City library (north-west of the main plaza), go inside.
blocks.text: Travel to the TzHaar City library (north-west of the main plaza), go inside.

blocks.html: Talk to Trindine.
blocks.text: Talk to Trindine.

blocks.html: Travel to the Wizards' Tower (use the wicked hood, stardust, or traveller's necklace to teleport)
blocks.text: Travel to the Wizards' Tower (use the wicked hood, stardust, or traveller's necklace to teleport)

blocks.html: Talk to Wizard Trindy on the ground floor (UK) / 1st floor (US) at the entrance of the Wizards' Tower.
blocks.text: Talk to Wizard Trindy on the ground floor (UK) / 1st floor (US) at the entrance of the Wizards' Tower.

blocks.html: Search four bookcases to the west.
blocks.text: Search four bookcases to the west.

blocks.html: Talk to Wizard Trindy at the eastern bookcases.
blocks.text: Talk to Wizard Trindy at the eastern bookcases.

blocks.html: Return to Kharid-et Dig Site's praetorium war table.
blocks.text: Return to Kharid-et Dig Site's praetorium war table.

blocks.html: Talk to Azzanadra.
blocks.text: Talk to Azzanadra.

blocks.html: Travel to the entrance of the Heart of Gielinor.
blocks.text: Travel to the entrance of the Heart of Gielinor.

substeps.html: Use The Heart teleport and leave by the wooden lift.
substeps.text: Use The Heart teleport and leave by the wooden lift.

substeps.html: See other fast travel options if not using The Heart teleport.
substeps.text: See other fast travel options if not using The Heart teleport.

blocks.text: Talk to Azzanadra.

blocks.html: Enter the Heart and continue the dialogue.
blocks.text: Enter the Heart and continue the dialogue.

blocks.html: Observe each of the eggs at the end of the corridors.
blocks.text: Observe each of the eggs at the end of the corridors.

blocks.text: Talk to Ariane.

blocks.html: Return to Kharid-et and enter to the main fortress.
blocks.text: Return to Kharid-et and enter to the main fortress.

blocks.html: Walk to the praetorium war table (you need to walk into the room where the table is to start the dialogue).
blocks.text: Walk to the praetorium war table (you need to walk into the room where the table is to start the dialogue).

blocks.html: Stand next to any four shadow anchors around Kharid-et (see the map).
blocks.text: Stand next to any four shadow anchors around Kharid-et (see the map).

blocks.html: Harvest Trindine wisps until you get 50 memories.
blocks.text: Harvest Trindine wisps until you get 50 memories.

blocks.text: Inspect the blank observation and finish the dialogue or Ga'al will not spawn for the next step.

blocks.text: Return to the TzHaar City main plaza.

blocks.text: Talk to Ga'al in the main plaza.

blocks.text: Return to the Wizards' Tower.

blocks.html: Walk to the entrance to trigger the dialogue.

blocks.text: Return to the Hall of Memories and enter the pool.

blocks.text: Return to the Heart of Gielinor (enter from the entrance).
